responsibility: Shared language-hook declaration and macro wiring for the C++ and Objective-C++ front ends. It declares the common helper entry points and maps GCC’s LANG_HOOKS interface to cp-specific implementations for parsing, type creation, diagnostics, gimplification, DWARF/debug behavior, OpenMP semantics, attribute handling, aliasing, pretty-printing, and declaration management, leaving only the few language-unique hooks to cp-lang.cc or objcp-lang.cc.
same_name_distinction: Acts as the declaration and macro-wiring layer for shared C++/Objective-C++ language hooks, mapping LANG_HOOKS to cp-specific entry points and declaring common helpers. Unlike cp-objcp-common.cc, it does not implement the hook behavior; it defines how the front ends attach to it.
